description: This file contains a benchmarking implementation for Orleans grains, specifically testing stateless worker grains' performance and dynamic worker pool management. It defines benchmark classes, grain interfaces, and grain implementations with performance measurement logic.

classes.name: StatelessWorkerBenchmark
classes.description: Benchmark class for measuring stateless worker grain performance and adaptive pool management using Orleans hosting.

classes.name: BenchmarkConstants
classes.description: Contains configuration constants for the benchmarking process, such as maximum worker limit and process delay.

classes.name: IProcessorGrain
classes.description: Interface for processor grains, extending IGrainWithIntegerKey, with a Process method.

classes.name: IAdaptiveGrain
classes.description: Marker interface extending IProcessorGrain for adaptive worker grains.

classes.name: IMonotonicGrain
classes.description: Marker interface extending IProcessorGrain for monotonic worker grains.

classes.name: SWMonotonicGrain
classes.description: Stateless worker grain with removeIdleWorkers set to false, implementing monotonic worker behavior.

classes.name: SWAdaptiveGrain
classes.description: Stateless worker grain with removeIdleWorkers set to true, implementing adaptive worker behavior.

classes.name: BaseGrain<T>
classes.description: Abstract generic class implementing common worker statistics and lifecycle tracking for grains, including active worker count, max active workers, and elapsed time metrics.

methods.name: StatelessWorkerBenchmark
methods.description: Constructor for setting up Orleans host and grain factory.

methods.name: Dispose
methods.description: Stops the Orleans host and disposes resources.

methods.name: RunAsync
methods.description: Runs the benchmark process asynchronously for specific grain types.

methods.name: Run<T, H>
methods.description: Private static method executing the benchmark logic for specific grain interface and implementation types, involving task generation, cooldowns, and stats reporting.
